summary: This bill expands Medicare coverage to include dental, vision, and hearing services, as well as dentures, eyeglasses, contact lenses, low vision devices, and hearing aids, with phased-in payment amounts and certain limitations on frequency and cost.

scores.thoughts: This bill significantly expands Medicare coverage to include dental, vision, and hearing care, which are currently largely excluded. This represents a major expansion of public healthcare benefits for seniors and certain low-income individuals, moving towards more public healthcare provision.

By expanding Medicare benefits to cover dental, vision, and hearing services, this bill strengthens the social safety net for elderly and disabled individuals who rely on Medicare. It reduces out-of-pocket costs for essential health services, particularly for low-income beneficiaries.

The bill creates new mandatory Medicare spending for dental, vision, and hearing benefits with no offsets, revenue increases, or spending reductions elsewhere, directly increasing the federal deficit.
The entire bill expands Medicare to cover dental, vision, and hearing services, representing direct government action to expand coverage and lower beneficiary costs.
